subject: gov.legislate
name: AI legislation or regulations
what_would_settle_it: an AI Act, or regulations made under an existing statute, with a gazette reference

subject: gov.standards
name: National IPv6 transition plan
what_would_settle_it: a regulator or ministry IPv6 transition plan with a target date, or a published IPv6 adoption percentage for Botswana

subject: finance.budget
name: Audited outturn for digital budget lines
what_would_settle_it: the Auditor General's report on the accounts of the Government of Botswana for FY2024/25 or FY2025/26

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National Cybersecurity Strategy
what_would_settle_it: the strategy document itself, or a gazette notice or ministerial statement giving its date of adoption and version

subject: dpi.registry
name: National address register
what_would_settle_it: a national addressing standard or register with a coverage figure, or a ministerial statement that none is planned

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital literacy measure
what_would_settle_it: a dated statistics-office or regulator household ICT survey reporting a digital-literacy or digital-skills rate

subject: include.access
name: Official internet penetration figure
what_would_settle_it: the regulator's annual report, or a statistics-office household ICT access survey

subject: data.statistics
name: Gambling participation statistics
what_would_settle_it: An official participation series, an age breakdown or any independent research establishing who is betting, at what age and with whose money. None is held as the legal betting age is being lowered.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Universal Access and Service Fund receipts and disbursements
what_would_settle_it: the fund's audited annual accounts or BOCRA annual-report figures for levy receipts, surplus transfers and disbursements would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, the framework states the sources but no held document gives their scale

subject: finance.sustain
name: Financing source of recurrent digital lines
what_would_settle_it: the recurrent estimates print no financing column; a statement of whether any recurrent digital spending is externally financed would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, none held

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: State control of identity-system source code and support contracts
what_would_settle_it: the identity system's support contracts, or a ministry statement on source-code ownership and exit terms, would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, the latest held account is the 2018 ID4D diagnostic

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data terms of the ADHDS health partnership
what_would_settle_it: publication of the agreement's data-residency, portability and exit clauses would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, neither party's announcement states them

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Where the state's AI compute and models are hosted
what_would_settle_it: a national AI policy or strategy addressing hosting, compute and model ownership would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, the policy was still in drafting
